'''Leww''' was the [[Gender/Legends|male]] shopkeeper of a male clothing store located in [[Isttu Village]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
